privacy.title: Your letters are personal. We treat them that way.

points.title: Analysed, not used for training
points.text: Photos are analysed by Google's Gemini model via Firebase / Vertex AI to create your explanation. They are not used to train AI models.

points.title: Saved letters stay on your phone
points.text: We do not store your letters on our servers. What you save in the app is kept on your device.

points.title: No account needed

points.title: No ads

points.title: Analytics only with consent
points.text: Usage analytics are switched on only if you agree in the app. You can change this at any time.

items.a: MemoPic is a mobile app for newcomers in Germany. You photograph a German letter, and the app explains in your language what it is, who sent it, what you have to do and by when. It suggests a polite reply in German, reminds you of the deadline and turns the key phrases into short daily lessons and speaking practice.

Typical letters from the Jobcenter, Finanzamt, Ausländerbehörde, Bürgeramt, the Rundfunkbeitrag (Beitragsservice), your Krankenkasse, your landlord, as well as payment reminders (Mahnung) and Inkasso letters. You can also photograph other everyday German documents.
The app interface is available in English, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Arabic and Uzbek. Explanations of your letters can be given in many more languages.

Yes, there is a free plan. MemoPic Pro is an optional subscription with a 7-day free trial. Prices are shown in the App Store or Google Play for your country, and you can cancel at any time in your store account settings.

items.q: Can I rely on the explanation?
items.a: MemoPic uses AI and can make mistakes. Always check the original letter, especially names, amounts and dates. MemoPic gives general information, not legal or tax advice. For important matters, contact the sender or a free counselling service such as the Migrationsberatung für erwachsene Zuwanderer (MBE).

items.q: What happens to the photos of my letters?
items.a: The photo is sent to Google's Gemini model via Firebase / Vertex AI only to create your explanation. It is not used to train AI models. We do not store your letters on our servers — letters you save stay on your phone.
No. You can use MemoPic without registering, without a password and without giving us your email address.

items.q: How does the speaking practice work?
items.a: You choose a situation — for example calling the Jobcenter, an appointment at the Ausländerbehörde, the doctor or your landlord — and talk to an AI partner. You get corrections and better phrasing. Speech recognition uses your phone's built-in speech service.

items.q: How do I learn the German from my letters?
items.a: Key phrases from your letters are added to a spaced-repetition review, so you see them again just before you would forget them. A daily goal and streak help you keep going.

items.q: Is MemoPic connected to the Jobcenter or other authorities?
items.a: No. MemoPic is an independent app by TIYN ZAYTUN LLC and is not affiliated with any German authority, insurer or company.
